authoredFrom: SOL-21 — cross-file resolution, the BASE half. Authored 2026-09-30 from the analyzer's measured output.
note: A fixture in a SUBDIRECTORY is a PROJECT: the runner indexes every source file in that directory and hands the result to `AnalyzeContext.projectIndex`. This is opt-in by structure — every flat fixture still gets no context, which is why the 27 pre-existing Solidity expectations are unchanged by any of it. Without that mechanism a lane whose analyzer reads the index cannot be tested at all, and two Solidity mutants survived their first run for exactly this reason: the runner called `analyze()` with no context, so both were no-ops against zero rows.

expectRelationships.comment: An IN-FILE interface base, resolved by the tree alone. This row is the pre-existing SOL-5 behaviour and needs no index — pinned so that adding the index cannot be mistaken for what settled THIS edge.
